is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae s.s., An. coluzzii, and An. arabiensis).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for the Ace-1 G280S (G119S) mutation (Table 1).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 provides the number of mosquitoes tested and the genotype counts (119S/119S, 119S/119G, 119G/119G) for each species and location.

african_field_population.evidence: Larvae were collected from 20 districts in Benin and reared to adults.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting new field data collected between 2022 and 2024.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides data for 20 specific districts in Benin (e.g., Cotonou, Sèmè-Kpodji, Parakou, etc.) and includes a map (Fig. 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted from January 2022 to December 2024, which is a 3-year window.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study reports new field collections conducted between 2022 and 2024.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and bioassay results, are provided in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study investigated pirimiphos-methyl resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations across 20 districts in Benin from 2022 to 2024. It reports bioassay mortality rates and the frequency of the Ace-1 G119S mutation across three sibling species.
